changeSet.author: eop

preConditions.onFailMessage: player holds seat_order values outside 0..5, which this changeset is about to forbid. Find them with: SELECT id, game_session_id, seat_order FROM player WHERE seat_order NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 5. Correct or remove those rows, then deploy again.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player WHERE seat_order NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 5

changeSet.comment: Add CHECK constraint to ensure player.seat_order is within the valid range 0..5. This bound is derived from GameSession.MAXIMUM_PLAYERS = 6, so valid seats are 0 through 5 inclusive. This single CHECK fixes the seat range on hand and trick_play too, because fk_hand_player_seat and fk_trick_play_player_seat bind those columns to player (id, seat_order) and therefore inherit whatever player permits. See ADR-023 line 1192.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE player ADD CONSTRAINT chk_player_seat_order CHECK (seat_order BETWEEN 0 AND 5)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE player DROP CONSTRAINT chk_player_seat_order

changeSet.author: eop

preConditions.onFailMessage: trick holds sequence values below 1, which this changeset is about to forbid. Find them with: SELECT id, game_session_id, sequence FROM trick WHERE sequence < 1. Correct or remove those rows, then deploy again.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trick WHERE sequence < 1

changeSet.comment: Add CHECK constraint to ensure trick.sequence is 1-based as documented in changeset 004. No upper bound is derivable: at three players a session runs to ceil(68 / 3) = 23 tricks, but no domain constant bounds it, and the deck size that figure derives from is not a constant this file can read.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE trick ADD CONSTRAINT chk_trick_sequence CHECK (sequence >= 1)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE trick DROP CONSTRAINT chk_trick_sequence

changeSet.author: eop

preConditions.onFailMessage: game_session holds current_leader_seat values outside 0..5, which this changeset is about to forbid. Find them with: SELECT id, status, current_leader_seat FROM game_session WHERE current_leader_seat IS NOT NULL AND current_leader_seat NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 5. Correct or remove those rows, then deploy again.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_session WHERE current_leader_seat IS NOT NULL AND current_leader_seat NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 5

changeSet.comment: Add CHECK constraint to ensure game_session.current_leader_seat is within the valid range 0..5, or NULL. The column was added in changeset 004 and is nullable because it is unset in LOBBY and written at deal completion.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE game_session ADD CONSTRAINT chk_game_session_current_leader_seat CHECK (current_leader_seat IS NULL OR current_leader_seat BETWEEN 0 AND 5)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE game_session DROP CONSTRAINT chk_game_session_current_leader_seat
